annotations.title: Check a quoted HRV or ERV

description: Checks a quoted HRV or ERV against bedroom airflow needs using exact-model HVI-certified data. Returns a screening verdict, reasons, assumptions and questions for the installer. Ambiguous model names return candidates for clarification rather than a guessed model. Does not provide a permit-ready design or guarantee installation performance.

bedrooms.description: Every bedroom, with how many people sleep in each

name.description: What the household calls the room, e.g. "Main bedroom"

sleepers.description: People who sleep there (a large dog counts about like a person)

floorAreaSqft.description: Conditioned floor area in square feet, for the daytime code rate

model.description: The brand and model exactly as the quote prints it, e.g. "Broan-NuTone B160E75RS"

quotedType.description: Whether the quote calls it an HRV or an ERV, to catch a mismatch

unitId.description: An id from a previous result’s candidates, once the person has said which exact model it is

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code (used for the state if state is missing)

name: check_ventilation_unit
